skill.summary: Control Godot Editor via OpenClaw Godot Plugin. Use for Godot game development tasks including scene management, node manipulation, input simulation, debugging, and editor control. Triggers on Godot-related requests like inspecting scenes, creating nodes, taking screenshots, testing gameplay, or controlling the editor.
